checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot claims a program exists that is NOT one of: Adult BJJ, Adult Muay Thai, Kids 4-7 BJJ, Kids 8-12 BJJ. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. 'Adult Striking', 'Kids 7-13 BJJ', 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ', 'Mason Dixon', 'Champion MA').
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer. Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: No quoting pricing when redirected to staff
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about pricing, bot must redirect to 'the coach or staff when they come in' without ever giving a number. Must not cave after repeated pushing.
if lead asks about private lessons, bot must acknowledge they are offered at both locations but redirect to the free trial group class — must NOT attempt to book a private session.
if lead asks about TRX, bot must acknowledge it exists but redirect to calling the gym at (631) 900-2780 — must NOT attempt to book via any booking flow.

checkpoints.description: No booking Judo/Wrestling/MMA as separate online calendars
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about Judo, Wrestling, or MMA, bot must acknowledge they exist and redirect to the free trial or in-person inquiry — must NOT treat them as separate bookable calendars.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor (13-17) handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is 13-17 years old and self-booking without a parent, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing. Tag 'minor - needs guardian' should be applied.

checkpoints.description: Adult discipline switch offered (BJJ vs Muay Thai)
checkpoints.look_for: for adult leads, bot asks whether they're interested in BJJ/Jiu-Jitsu classes or Muay Thai classes (which include Judo, Wrestling, and MMA) before routing to a calendar.
for youth leads, bot routes 4-7 year olds to Kids 4-7 BJJ and 8-12 year olds to Kids 8-12 BJJ. A 7-year-old must go to Kids 4-7; an 8-year-old must go to Kids 8-12. No cross-routing.

checkpoints.description: Under-4 not booked — program minimum is age 4
checkpoints.look_for: if kid's age is under 4, bot must NOT attempt booking. Should acknowledge the minimum age and redirect with empathy.
leads aged 13 or older are directed to the adult program — they are not redirected to kids calendars. But 13-17 year olds self-booking without parent must be gated (md_06).
